note: The source of truth for which texture set each of the twenty semantic families uses, and how it was produced. tools/assets/fetch-cc0-materials.mjs and tools/assets/synth-materials.mjs read this file; game/assets/w1-30/materials/manifest.json is generated from it with hashes. A family with no entry here cannot reach a frame: worldMaterial falls back to the visible magenta material.

cc0.note: Poly Haven releases all library assets under CC0 and permits commercial use and redistribution.

conversion.why_desaturated: The source sets carry their own strong colour identity (rusty orange, red leather). Black Marsh's regional palette must lead, so albedo is desaturated to 0.55 at conversion: pigment variation survives, the source's colour opinion does not. The former pipeline went further and neutralised colour entirely, which is one reason the province reads as grey.
conversion.why_rough_at_512: Roughness is a low-frequency signal; halving it costs nothing visible and takes the whole library under the 320 MB high-tier texture budget without a KTX2 toolchain.
conversion.adjust: Per-slug ffmpeg eq adjustments, applied after the shared desaturation, recorded in families[].adjust. They exist because two of the source sets are lit far brighter than a Black Marsh frame and came out of the close-up rig as white paper.

stone.why_changed: plastered_stone_wall, clay_plaster and white_plaster_rough_01 are all plaster: the close-up rig showed clay, stone and salt reading as one material, which fails the distinguishability gate before a judge ever sees it. Coral masonry is also more Black Marsh than render-farm plaster.

salt.why_changed: same finding; a bleached rock face reads as a salt tusk and does not read as plaster.

chitin.why: No CC0 set in the corpus reads as insect carapace. Voronoi plate cells with a bevelled rim and per-cell gloss, synthesised by tools/assets/synth-materials.mjs. Recorded as a substitution under W1-30C's stop condition.

resin.why: No CC0 set reads as sap resin. Flow-banded surface with bubble cavities, same script, same reason.

water.why: Water's appearance is owned by the surface shader (W1-30H after the W1-30S seam). C supplies only a ripple normal so the shader has a high-frequency term to break its specular lobe.

wet_chitin.why: wet_chitin is the wetness variant of chitin, not a second texture set. A second set for the same surface is a census duplicate; this is what the variant axis is for.

detail_normals.note: Four shared 512 px detail-normal tiles, blended at 8x the base tiling. This is how a 1k base texture survives a 0.5 m close-up, and it costs four textures for the whole game.

tiles.organic: fibrous directional grain with pores - wood, foliage
tiles.mineral: cellular pitting with sub-grain - soil, stone, salt, metal
tiles.fabric: woven warp/weft crossing - cloth, skin, water
tiles.hard: fine cracked plating - carapace, shell, bone, resin

trim_atlas.note: One band per slot declared in TRIM_SLOTS. Consumed by W1-30E's kit parts and W1-30D's equipment.
